name: Custom TOC
description: Adds a TOC-overrides field type, CKEditor widget, and formatter that generate and render a Table of Contents from a formatted-text source field.
project_description: Custom TOC provides a single field type (toc_link_overrides, label "TOC (CKEditor)") plus its widget and formatter that generate a Table of Contents from a chosen formatted-text source field and store the result as editable HTML. The CKEditor-backed widget offers a "Regenerate TOC" button that runs the source field's headings through the toc_api service to build starter TOC markup, which editors can then refine by hand. A node form alter seeds the initial TOC on edit forms, and a node_view hook places (or replaces an already-injected) TOC in the rendered output, keeping the published page consistent with the stored field value. Requires the toc_api module and Drupal core 10 or 11.
